summary: The note describes the gooseberry plant as native to many parts of Europe and western Asia. It says the plant grows naturally in alpine thickets and rocky woods in lower-elevation areas, ranging from France eastward into the Himalayas and peninsular India.
one_line: Overview of the gooseberry plant's native range across Europe, western Asia, the Himalayas and peninsular India.
key_facts: The gooseberry is indigenous to many parts of Europe and western Asia.
The gooseberry grows naturally in alpine thickets and rocky woods in the lower country.
The gooseberry's natural range extends from France eastward.
The gooseberry's natural range extends well into the Himalayas.
The gooseberry's natural range extends into peninsular India.
